digest.component_or_area: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md documentation; close ticket workflow
propositions: AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md incorrectly state the close precheck requires a MERGED rebar-ticket commit, but the implementation in _referencing_commit_exists scans all HEAD-reachable history with no merge-status check
The close precheck is conditional on file_impact being recorded and the completion-verification gate being enabled, not unconditional as documented
A referencing commit satisfying the precheck may be an unlanded local commit on the current branch referencing the ticket or any transitive descendant, not just merged commits
The AGENTS.md close bullet omits documentation of rebar transition --ref, the sanctioned tool for closing a stacked story against its own commit without moving the worktree
The land-before-close ordering is enforced by the Verified +1 policy rule, not by the precheck mechanism as the docs imply
The rebar transition --ref option retargets completion verification and signature to a specific ref tree but does not narrow the referencing-commit scan, a distinction the docs must clarify
